name.en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಜೀವನ ಜ್ಯೋತಿ ಬಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ

benefit.en: Rs 2 lakh life insurance cover for death due to any reason. One-year cover, renewable every year. Premium: Rs 436 per year, deducted from your account.

why.en: No insurance on file, and you have a bank account.
why.kn: ನಿಮಗೆ ವಿಮೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ ಇದೆ.

eligibility_text.en: Bank or post office account holders aged 18 (completed) to 50 who give consent to join and enable auto-debit. You can join through one bank or post office account only. Cover ends at age 55, with yearly renewal.

documents.en: Bank or post office account with enough balance for the yearly premium
Aadhaar (the main KYC for the bank or post office account)
Enrolment and auto-debit consent form (the bank or post office gives the prescribed form)

how_to_apply.en: Give your consent and auto-debit option on the prescribed form to your bank or post office. The premium of Rs 436 per year is then deducted from your account in one payment. The cover runs 1 June to 31 May, and joining late costs less premium.

why.en: No insurance on file, and you have a bank account.
why.kn: ನಿಮಗೆ ವಿಮೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ ಇದೆ.
